sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone still has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-310 is made of EN AW-6082-T5, so the open-issue rule applies even though the change is packing only. The Chisone re-audit on 2026-11-05 did not close this 8D. The 40-per-layer packing itself is covered by valid deviation DEV-125 (2026-08-01 to 2027-01-31). Supplier standing is approved (QS-C-2026), and the BR-310 release for Chisone at PLT-PIN/CUST-NOR is valid (APR-003). Nordhavn's requirements do not cover packaging.
